title: China Building Materials Industry Key Laboratory of Aerogel Materials, Nanjing Tech University
content: Aerogel National Laboratory. The China Building Materials Industry Key Laboratory of Aerogel Materials at Nanjing Tech University is a dedicated aerogel laboratory platform serving the building materials sector. Because its official scope is directly centered on aerogel materials, it is highly relevant for aerogel research, technical development, and industry-facing collaboration.
